summary.text: Julie Mayfield is a Democratic member of the North Carolina State Senate who has represented District 49 since January 2021 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
An environmental attorney and nonprofit leader from Asheville, she previously served on the Asheville City Council.

paragraphs.text: Julie Mayfield was born in Atlanta, Georgia, and lives in Asheville, North Carolina, according to Ballotpedia.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Davidson College in 1989 and a law degree from Emory Law School in 1996.
Her career experience includes working as vice president and general counsel of the Georgia Conservancy, as an attorney and as co-director of MountainTrue.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Mayfield described herself as a public interest environmental attorney and policy advocate for 25 years who served five years on the Asheville City Council before her election to the Senate.
She assumed office in the Senate on January 1, 2021, succeeding Terry Van Duyn.

For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments as Agriculture, Energy, and Environment; Appropriations on Agriculture, Natural and Economic Resources; Health Care; Transportation; and Rules and Operations of the Senate.
In the survey, she said she played a leading role in the Senate in the 2021 adoption of H951, a bipartisan clean energy bill, and named a "Green New Deal for NC" among her key messages.
